description: GameForge AI Studio — web-based AI game development studio (Genex-inspired, original implementation)
name: gameforge-ai-studio

scripts.build: npm run build:foundation && npm run build:core && npm run build:apps
scripts.build:foundation: npm run build --workspace @gameforge/shared && npm run build --workspace @gameforge/plugin-sdk && npm run build --workspace @gameforge/model-providers
scripts.build:core: npm run build --workspace @gameforge/agent-core && npm run build --workspace @gameforge/test-runner && npm run build --workspace gameforge-runner
scripts.build:apps: npm run build --workspace gameforge-api && npm run build --workspace gameforge-worker && npm run build --workspace gameforge-web && npm run build --workspace @gameforge/plugin-asset-thumbnail && npm run build --workspace @gameforge/plugin-procedural-geometry
